_doc: Weapon types (openspec/changes/battle-console-engine/design.md section 3). Ported from the battle console mockup's WEAPONS table (docs/mockups/battle-console.html); every number a placeholder until the combat change. kind: beam hits at once; torpedo, bolt and missile fly at speed_m_s; pd shoots down shots in flight. aim (openspec/changes/weapon-targeting): precise puts a hit on the aimed subsystem when the facing struck exposes it; arc lands anywhere the facing exposes (data/battle/systems/tactical.json strike). own_power: charges from its own generator, never the capacitor or the battery, and fires whatever weapons control's state. The arming modes besides Offline and Normal (openspec/changes/weapon-arming): overload (more damage, a longer charge, at short range only) and proximity (a torpedo fused to burst beside its target: the normal range, charge and cost, damage instead of the normal damage, hit_bonus added to the chance to hit, the target's speed ignored when ignore_speed, and a chopping block reach_deg either side of the facing struck).
